summary.headline: Astrological Questions 361–382
summary.text: Astrological question list nos. 361–382, covering distance, fugitives, love and hate, illness, death, truth, rumors, justice, succession, theft, mundane outcomes, solar and lunar eclipses, chronocrators, abundance and scarcity, heat diagnosis, and Mercury’s affliction, with manuscript folio references and cross-references to Florentine codices.
